walkthroughs.body_html:
In 1961 Albert Bandura showed children adults hitting a Bobo doll.

The kids then copied — punching the doll too. 🥊

Children copy role models they see. So do teenagers.

Models can be:

  • Parents.
  • Older siblings.
  • Celebrities or influencers.

Vicarious learning = watching what happens to others.

See a friend praised for sharing → you share more.

See another get told off → you avoid the same.

You don't need to do it yourself to learn. 👀

options: Being directly rewarded for copying someone.
Learning by observing the consequences others receive for behaviour.
